window_policy: Only original complete exported windows, no extension/free tail, cut-window search, resampling, interpolation or posthoc tolerance.
columns: Original NPZ t_s,P_I_kN,P_J_kN,U1_mm,U1_m,force_I_row,force_J_row,deformation_row. I and J duplicate, use I once.
force_ratio: FT/Pmax signed and abs(FT)/Pmax; Pmax=max(abs(P_I)); zero denominator => undefined not0.
net_change_scale: s=max_t abs(d(t)-d0), original window, unitsm/mm. Report signed (dT-d0)/s and abs(dT-d0)/s. If s==0, explicit undefined.
units: Force kN; U1 originalmm and convertedm; time seconds. Preserve signed endpoints, net total deformation change and I/J/U1 source cells at both endpoints.
interpretation: Exact exported equality only. Nonzero floating export is not engineering significance. Endpoint sample F0=FT=0 is at most numerical evidence for sample-boundary force precondition, not certification of continuous physical ports/parameters. No continuous V certified by sample differences, no Dport as true D, no delta-return requirement added.
no_operations: No Excel read, fit, solver, extra histories, or shared/old-output/Git changes.
